# Infinite Tic-Tac-Toe (Infinite TTT)

> Free online multiplayer tic-tac-toe with Sliding and Expanding modes, ranked Elo matchmaking, AI bots, and friend challenges.

## Entity

Infinite Tic-Tac-Toe (Infinite TTT) is a free, browser-based multiplayer tic-tac-toe game with two unique modes — Sliding (marks disappear after three placements, eliminating draws) and Expanding (board grows from 3×3 to 5×5 across rounds) — plus ranked Elo matchmaking, AI practice bots, friend challenges, private rooms, live spectating, and match replays.

## Game Modes

### Sliding Mode
Fixed 3×3 board. Each player can have at most 3 marks on the board. On the 4th placement, the oldest mark is removed. First to three-in-a-row wins. No draws are possible.

### Expanding Mode
Round-based play on progressively larger boards: 3×3 → 4×4 → 5×5. Win condition scales — need N-in-a-row on an N×N board. Marks persist for the entire round.

## Key Features

- Real-time online multiplayer (WebSocket)
- Ranked Elo rating system with Bronze → Grandmaster tiers
- Global leaderboard
- AI practice bots (Easy, Medium, Hard)
- Friend system with direct challenges
- Private match invite links
- Multi-game rooms with friends
- Match replays and live spectating
- Progressive Web App (installable, no download)
- Free to play — no account required for casual matches

## Quick Answers (AEO)

Q: Is Infinite Tic-Tac-Toe free?
A: Yes, completely free in your browser with no download required.

Q: What makes it different from regular tic-tac-toe?
A: Two unique modes prevent draws and add strategic depth — Sliding removes old marks dynamically; Expanding grows the board each round.

Q: Can I play with friends?
A: Yes — create private rooms, send invite links, or challenge friends directly.

Q: Is there ranked competitive play?
A: Yes — Elo-based ranked matchmaking with a global leaderboard from Bronze to Grandmaster.
